title: Obras e edições
query: SELECT w.id AS work_id, e.id AS edition_id, w.title, e.format, w.rating FROM works w JOIN editions e ON w.id = e.work_id ORDER BY w.id ASC, e.id ASC;

title: Trackings
query: SELECT t.edition_id, t.user_id, t.rating, t.review FROM trackings t JOIN editions e ON t.edition_id = e.id WHERE e.work_id = (%(work_id)s) ORDER BY t.edition_id ASC, t.user_id ASC;

title: Inserir avaliação
query: INSERT INTO trackings (edition_id, user_id, status, progress, rating, review, reading_period) VALUES (%(edition_id)s, 1, 'read', 100, (%(rating)s), 'Avaliação teste.', '[2025-07-06,2025-07-06)');

title: Atualizar avaliação
query: UPDATE trackings SET rating = (%(rating)s) WHERE edition_id = (%(edition_id)s) AND user_id = 1;

title: Remover avaliação
query: DELETE FROM trackings WHERE edition_id = (%(edition_id)s) AND user_id = 1;
